tips.text: Buy all four blueprints from Amir with standing; it beats the drop route.
Farm parts in Hell-Scrub to Rotation C, not Legacyte Harvest; Techrot or Scaldra makes no difference.
Avoid Legacyte Harvest; Legacytes resist crowd control, soak damage and drag every round out.
Expect the daily standing cap, not the bounties, to be the limit; a few top-tier bounties fill it.
Pick up Hex Treasures during missions and hand them to Lettie to top off the cap.
Clear all three Temporal Archimedea missions for 15,000 standing at once at Rank 5.
Bring a treasure finder such as Orokin Eye air support to ping every Hex Treasure.
Take bounties that feature the member you still need; their daily chemistry builds while you farm standing.
Gift from the DirectGiftz shop to skip the KIM chats; community wishlist posts list what each member likes.
Farm the Argon Crystal last; it is the only input that decays in your inventory.
Players call Hex standing one of the easiest syndicate grinds; the chemistry gate is the tedious part.
